en: Grunt
Hold it! The crater isn't safe right now. Something huge is coming, and I'm keeping watch for it.
{rival}
{player}! You got here first? I ran the whole way from Route 21 and you still beat me.
So this is the Giant Chasm. It's freezing in here... That has to be Kyurem's doing.
Grunt
Psst! Easy, easy. I'm not one of them. Rood of the old Team Plasma asked me to keep watch in these clothes.
Their ship came down in the crater up this way. The new Team Plasma are guarding it, and Rood has gone to face them.
{rival}
The old Team Plasma, standing up to the new one? Then we'd better hurry before they get hurt!
Grunt
I'll go back and tell the others that help has come. Thank you, really!
{rival}
Come on, {player}! My sister's Purrloin could be on that ship!
Grunt
This crater's no place to be right now. Something huge is on its way here, and I'm watching for it.
...Don't tell anyone, but I'm with Rood. Go and help the people of Humilau first, all right?
You came! Their ship is up in the crater. Go on and I'll warn the others.
Grunt
Nobody goes out this way! Lord Ghetsis's orders!
